title: endelgato's fps booster
description: This is everything i can put in a modpack to help fps. I made it with nothing really extra except fullbright. I hope you like it!
body:
# **IMPORTANT**
 **ONLY FOR 1.21.11 USE THE CUSTOM JAVA ARGUMENT** 
```
--add-modules jdk.incubator.vector
```
 **TO ENABLE GPU BOOSTER**
